get.summary: Get the packing checklist for a trip
get.description: Returns the trip checklist. Automatically initialized from the global template if it does not exist yet.

checks.description: Keys are `<itemId>|<location>` (location is the name of a location label, including a deleted one the unit still carries, or empty for an item without a storage location); only checked entries are present.

specChecks.description: Keys are `<specId>|<location>`; only checked entries are present.

post.summary: Add a packing occasion to a trip checklist

400.description: Missing, blank, or too long name

checks.description: Keys are `<itemId>|<location>` (location is the name of a location label, including a deleted one the unit still carries, or empty for an item without a storage location); only checked entries are present.

specChecks.description: Keys are `<specId>|<location>`; only checked entries are present.

400.description: Missing, blank, or too long name

delete.description: Rejected with 409 if this is the last remaining occasion.

put.summary: Set the checked state of an item at one of its storage locations within an occasion
put.description: Each storage location of an item is checked independently.

400.description: checked is not a boolean, or location is not a string or not one of the locations of the item

location.description: One of the storage locations of the item, i.e. a location label name (including a deleted one the item still carries); an empty string when it has none.

put.summary: Set the checked state of an item spec at one of its storage locations within an occasion
put.description: Each storage location of a spec is checked independently. A spec never inherits the locations of its item.

400.description: checked is not a boolean, or location is not a string or not one of the locations of the spec

404.description: Occasion, item, or spec not found

location.description: One of the storage locations of the spec, i.e. a location label name (including a deleted one the spec still carries); an empty string when it has none.

get.description: orphans lists names that trip checklist units are still filed under although no label with that name exists; re-creating a label with the same name makes them refer to it again.

put.description: Labels cannot be renamed: delete the label and add one with the new name instead.

400.description: show_as_group is not a boolean

delete.description: The name is removed from the checklist template. Trip checklists keep it: their units stay filed under the name and keep their checks, but the name cannot be added to a unit again unless a label with the same name is re-created.

200.description: Every automatic backup currently on disk, newest first
